Android will now ask for a few permissions. Here is what each one is for:
Location: your speed, the map, speed-camera alerts and trip records. It stays on the unit.
Music and photos: plays music from a USB stick, and your own pictures for the car and backgrounds.
Nearby devices: your phone\'s calls over Bluetooth, and OBD or tyre sensors if you have them.
Phone and calls: shows who is calling, and lets you answer and call back from the home screen.
Notifications: reminders such as a break after long driving.
You can refuse any of them; only that part stops working. Nothing is sent online.
